notes.title: FULL RELEASE IS AVAILABLE
KRAMPEN WILL BE CHARGEABLE
notes.notes:
[b][h3]WHY WILL THE GAME BECOME PAID?[/h3][/b]This was an incredibly difficult decision that took me a long time to make. I initially saw this project as something small, which is why I decided to make it free for everyone. It has now been two years since I started working on this project: I have invested my energy and time into it, compromised my health, and spent money on game assets. That said, I hope the game will gain some value, and I hope you're not upset by this news! A few of my friends have played the final version of the game, and they were all very impressed! The version currently available on Steam is not comparable to the one that stands today. Most of the old players will be satisfied with how far this project has evolved.

[b][h3]HOW MUCH WILL IT COST?[/h3][/b]First of all, the price is quite affordable: [b]$2.99[/b] + 15% discount at the game's launch. Secondly, "fan-pack" will be given for free to everyone who purchases the game! Lastly, I really hope for your support, as I'm apprehensive about my decision.

[b][h3]WILL THERE BE FUTURE UPDATES?[/h3][/b]Yes, but only minor updates for fixing any mistakes I may have made. I spend a lot of time ensuring that these issues do not arise and check every event by playing multiple times. In January-February, an [b]ENGLISH LANGUAGE[/b] option will be added, and when possible, I will definitely include cards, profile backgrounds, and a themed icon! Thank you for reading.
